title: audit-log-exporter: wire retention + export sinks into private installer and helm chart
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Private deployments require deterministic audit export and retention controls for compliance teams. This PR wires the existing audit-log-exporter into the private installer and Helm charts, exposes retention configuration and export sink plumbing (S3/GCS/Splunk/Syslog) via values and the terraform module, and adds upgrade/rollback hooks and migration notes. Changes include: Helm values for sinks and retention, Terraform variables and state-migration helper, installer wiring to enable exporter when audit_logging=true, RBAC and KMS key lookup for encrypted sinks, e2e smoke tests for sink delivery, and docs for operators. Motivation: customers running Redwood Private need an easy, auditable way to ensure logs are retained for X days and sent to approved export sinks. This reduces manual post-install steps and ensures consistent behaviour during upgrades/rollbacks. Implementation summary: 1) Helm chart: charts/audit-log-exporter - add values.auditExporter.enabled, values.auditExporter.retentionDays, values.auditExporter.sinks[] with typed sink configs; templates: deployment, secret, configmap updates to mount sink config and KMS key refs; post-upgrade hook job that validates sink connectivity. 2) Installer wiring: private-installer/templates - toggle installer to render audit-exporter resources when enabled, wire secrets from vault/KMS, update control-plane manifest generation. 3) Terraform: modules/audit_log_exporter - variables for retention_days, sinks, kms_key_id; helper script to migrate existing S3 bucket lifecycle rules if upgrading from older installer. 4) Tests: integration/ci - add smoke test job that deploys a single-node private variant with local S3 emulator and verifies retention policy metadata and sample export. 5) Docs: docs/private/audit-logging.md - operator guide and upgrade notes including manual rollback steps and troubleshooting. Rollout plan: staged rollout on release channel: enable by default in preview clusters, opt-in for customers on stable until +2 weeks of monitoring. Rollback: chart includes pre-delete hook to copy last 7 days of audit logs to temporary bucket; terraform module exposes replace_on_change flags for sink resources. Related work: follows on pr-18412 and pr-18458 (audit-log-exporter private wiring + retention sinks). Testing: CI ran initial matrix; lint/build passed, integration tests initially failed due to IAM permission timing in CI, fixed by adding a preflight IAM wait in installer, final run passed. Linear: ENG-2142 tracks the plumbing work, ENG-2187 tracks e2e coverage. Security review: verified that sink credentials are stored in sealed secrets and usage respects least-privilege KMS decrypt-only role. Ops notes: migration script provided for customers with existing S3 lifecycle rules to avoid double-deletion. Release notes: added 'audit logging retention and export sinks for private installer; operators can configure sinks and retentionDays via Helm/terraform'.

release_notes: Private installer: audit logging - added configurable retentionDays and export sink plumbing (S3/GCS/Splunk/Syslog). Includes Helm values, Terraform inputs, migration helper for S3 lifecycle rules, upgrade/rollback hooks, and operator docs.
notes_for_ops: When upgrading clusters with existing S3 lifecycle rules run installer/scripts/migrate_s3_lifecycle.sh prior to enabling the new exporter to avoid duplicate lifecycle policies. Ensure KMS decrypt role is granted to installer service principal. Post-upgrade hook will validate sink connectivity; check logs if validation fails.
